item.title: In case of a tie - Park Record
item.description: Ryan Dickey, congratulations on your election as Park City’s mayor — a contest decided by a seven-vote margin after a machine recount. This exceptionally close result underscores the diversity of views in our community and the mandate for leadership that listens to all voices. Your first significant action as mayor will involve guiding the appointment […]

item.title: Park City Pulse: New year, full calendar - Park Record
item.description: "As we kick off the new year with optimism, activity and a full calendar, we’re also grateful that Park City shines well beyond the slopes, with plenty for visitors and locals to do both on and off the mountain."

item.title: Green Tips: Driving or flying? - Park Record
item.description: "Sometimes, when traveling internationally or long distances, we have to fly. However, it’s worthwhile to compare driving and flying and how to reduce our emissions."

item.title: Park City Mountain announces night skiing and dinner series - Park Record
item.description: Three night skiing events across February and March will feature live entertainment and a dinner buffet at Legacy Lodge.

item.title: Way We Were: The muddled Morgan matter mined pure confusion - Park Record
item.description: "Even the masterful John Daly could find himself elbowed to the side of the dance hall from time to time."

item.title: Ridgelines: Finding my bearings on Park Peak - Park Record
item.description: "My first adventure on the new East Village Gondola came on a gray, blustery day as a much-needed winter storm moved in, bringing a mix of rain and snow and plenty of wind."

item.title: Writer-directors show the underground lives of fellow Iranians with their debut Sundance film - Park Record
item.description: “It's a very cinephile film. We try to bring our own artsy aesthetic,” co-writer-director Hossein Keshavarz said. “It's a film that is expressive. It's a film that has artistic vision. You don't know anything about Iran, but you can respond to the film as a work of cinema.”

item.title: ‘Together Forever’ brings Latter-day Saint experience to Sundance - Park Record
item.description: "Together Forever" follows a Latter-day Saint couple as they struggle through an unsexy honeymoon night.

item.title: Sundance short film ‘Cabbage Daddy’ gets wonderfully lost in translation - Park Record
item.description: “Cabbage Daddy,” filmmaker Grace An’s four-minute rush of colorful, poetic whiplash, began with a simple premise: “Why am I so bad at Korean?”

item.title: Park City vehicle fire temporarily closes road - Park Record
item.description: A vehicle fire required the temporary closure of one of the roads that provides access to upper Deer Valley on Wednesday morning.
